crossRefs.note: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and…

parallels.note: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

people.name: Chinnereth
people.line: Lake in northern Israel; and the plain on its north west

translations.web: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.
translations.bsb: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and moored the boat.
translations.kjv: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
translations.asv: And when they had crossed over, they came to the land unto Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.
